scope: Generated-image buttons and preselected image-to-3D form
behavior: Make a model links on completed gallery, private chat and joined-channel images
Reference preview, loading and unavailable-source states
Saved images prepared as JPEG copies up to 1600 pixels, preserving originals
Only fixed same-origin image endpoints and UUID references are used
Unsent writing confirmation and no inference before Create 3D model
The resulting model is private even when its source was visible in a channel

verification.source_sizes: The gallery fixture is an original 4096x768 PNG exceeding 8 MiB; the other source images are small generated fixtures.
assertions: Gallery, chat and channel buttons open the expected 3D route
Prepared references are JPEGs below the upload limit with matching SHA-256 and CSRF header
The large reference is resized to 1600 pixels wide
No generation request occurs merely by navigating
Dismissing the unsent-message confirmation preserves the chat draft
An unavailable source disables generation instead of reusing the previous image
Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow
verification.browser_mode: Deployed production bundle over validated HTTPS, with explicit API fixtures. Existing opt-in live edge boundary probe also passes.

limitations: No user images or live inference were used for these UI fixtures. Existing owner/channel authorization and geometry execution are unchanged. Natural-language 3D requests and shared model artifacts are not implemented here.
privacy_note: Historical deployment identifiers removed or replaced with illustrative values; original test outcomes retained.
